name: Chau Doc food guide
summary: Châu Đốc eats fish from the Hậu. Breakfast at Chợ Châu Đốc is bún cá with điên điển, chili, and lime, and the hall smells of mắm. Dinner is lẩu mắm, the pot Vietnam Tourism’s place page says not to leave without, and cá kho tộ with rice and greens. The charms chapter adds a seafood hotpot. Afternoon sweets are bánh bò thốt nốt, bánh bò Chăm, and chè thốt nốt.
body: The market is the morning. By 7:00 Vietnam Tourism’s dining chapter already has the hall in motion: noodle bowls, sugarcane juice, and stacks of fermented fish. VnExpress on 20 Oct 2023 prints the gate at 05:30–18:00. Come for the bowl, then the hill.

VnExpress adds cơm tấm, bánh hỏi thịt nướng, hủ tiếu bò viên, tung lò mò, bún mắm, gỏi sầu đâu, and chuối nếp nướng, and a 2023 day adds bún suông and chè bưởi. The ward names khô cá. The handbook names khô bò and đường thốt nốt. Can Tho’s bánh xèo is a different delta breakfast. Where two VnExpress prices disagree, both figures sit on the dish. Confirm a stall price on arrival.
specialtiesLead: Cá kho tộ is the claypot. Vietnam Tourism, VnExpress, UBND phường Châu Đốc, and the An Giang portal name the rest.

sections.heading: Chau Doc specialties
paragraphs: Twenty further dishes are named for Châu Đốc by Vietnam Tourism, VnExpress, the ward, or the province. A house number that was not printed is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Chau Doc Market
paragraphs: Come in the morning. VnExpress on 20 Oct 2023 prints 05:30–18:00 every day. Vietnam Tourism does not print a clock. Breakfast on the Hậu landing, in that same day, is hủ tiếu, bún mắm, or bún suông.

spots.name: Chau Doc Market
spots.caption: The hall for bún cá, mắm, and sugarcane juice. A street number was not printed.
spots.note: Morning bowls at the edge of the hall, and mắm in the aisles. VnExpress prints 05:30–18:00. Vietnam Tourism’s dining chapter says the hall is already busy by 7:00. A gate fee was not printed. Check on arrival.

spots.name: The blue hall
spots.caption: The same market from the street. Flowers, fruit, and the landing are the walk.
spots.note: A second frame of Chợ Châu Đốc. The same hall, seen from the street.

spots.name: Chau Doc floating market
spots.caption: Fruit and vegetables on the water, before the town is busy.
spots.note: Vietnam Tourism’s dining chapter: several dozen boats in the early morning, produce hung on long poles so a buyer can see it from far off. A clock and a landing name were not printed. Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Can Tho, if that breakfast is the point
paragraphs: Bánh xèo is the crepe on Vietnam Tourism’s Mekong dining chapter, the large turmeric one filled with pork, beansprouts, and shrimp. It is the neighbor’s breakfast. VnExpress on 20 Oct 2023 also lists it on the lunch menu inside Trà Sư, with cá lóc nướng, lẩu cá linh bông điên điển, cá linh chiên giòn, and gỏi cổ hũ dừa. That menu is one room.

seoTitle: Chau Doc food guide: market fish, mam, claypot
seoDescription: Châu Đốc food is bún cá and mắm at the market, lẩu mắm and cá kho tộ, palm sweets, and the other bowls Vietnam Tourism and VnExpress name. Confirm stall prices on arrival.
